basic_details.job_title: GIPE Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: GIPE has invited applications for one temporary Research Associate post on the project "Gap Assessment of ITDPs in Maharashtra". The remuneration is Rs. 35,000 to 40,000/- per month for a period of 6 months, extendable for another 2 months. Candidates need a BSc/BA and an MSc/MA in the listed subjects and knowledge of Marathi, and must be below 35 years of age. The application end date is 23 November 2026, till 6.00 p.m., and the online application fee is Rs. 236/-.

how_to_apply: The notice gives the application fee as "Application Fee (Online): Rs. 236/-" and the application end date as 23 November 2026, till 6.00 p.m. It prints no website address, application link, application form or list of documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is below 35 years, which means 35 itself is not covered. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Desirable, as printed in the notice: Ph.D. in Economics/ Development Studies/ Demography Experience & training in Development Issues and qualitative techniques OR Minimum one year of experience as research assistant on tribal/development related projects. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: BSc/BA in Economics, Sociology, Statistics, Social Work and MSc /MA in Economics, Sociology, Statistics, Social Work, Demography, Public Policy. Knowledge of Marathi language - spoken and writing.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate post is temporary and carries a remuneration of Rs. 35,000 to 40,000/- per month. The period is 6 months, extendable for another 2 months. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate posts has GIPE advertised?
faq.answer: GIPE has advertised 01 post of Research Associate for the project "Gap Assessment of ITDPs in Maharashtra".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the GIPE Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The application end date is 23 November 2026, till 6.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the GIPE Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice requires a BSc/BA in Economics, Sociology, Statistics, Social Work and an MSc/MA in Economics, Sociology, Statistics, Social Work, Demography, Public Policy, plus knowledge of Marathi, spoken and writing.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the GIPE Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the GIPE Research Associate?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 35,000 to 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GIPE Research Associate?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 236/-, shown in the notice as "Application Fee (Online)".

faq.question: Q7. Is the GIPE Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice lists the post type as Temporary, for a period of 6 months that is extendable for another 2 months.

faq.question: Q8. Is knowledge of Marathi required?
faq.answer: Yes. Knowledge of Marathi language, spoken and writing, is listed under the essential qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. What will the Research Associate do on the project?
faq.answer: The job description lists literature review, primary and secondary data collection, field work, tabulation, quantitative and qualitative analysis, and research assistance.

faq.question: Q10. What is desirable for the GIPE Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice lists as desirable a Ph.D. in Economics/ Development Studies/ Demography with experience and training in development issues and qualitative techniques, OR a minimum of one year of experience as research assistant on tribal/development related projects.
